'As an additional cost to play Express Lightning, you may **charge** your hero's soul.' Light Warrior Action - Attack. The ENTIRE printed text is one optional additional play cost, so it is authored as the TOP-LEVEL cost dict - the sanctioned shape for a card whose only implementable clause is that cost (loader.compile_card wires raw['cost'] -> CardDef.play_cost at loader.py:148-151). Same shape as the sibling .drafts/express_lightning_red.json / _blue.json - identical sentence across printings.

PLUMBING VERIFIED THIS SESSION: _compile_cost (loader.py:93-98) forwards every non-'type' key into params, so 'optional' reaches the handler; the CHARGE cost handler (cost_types.py:266-318) reads amount (default 1) and bool()s 'optional'/'may' RAW - hence 'optional' is authored as boolean true here. WARNING for future editors: the string "FALSE" would also read as OPTIONAL (bool('FALSE') is True); a mandatory CHARGE omits the key entirely. With optional set, can_pay returns True unconditionally, so DECLINING the charge never blocks the play - official release note 1 ('Charging is optional. You may play the card without charging') verbatim.

amount 1 is release note 2 ('You may only charge up to one card unless otherwise specified').

Release note 3 ('A card may not charge itself') holds BY CONSTRUCTION, not by authoring: the played card leaves its source zone before play_cost.pay_fn runs, so it is never among the hand cards the CHARGE prompt offers.

Release notes 4-5 need nothing authored: pay routes the chosen hand card through canonical effect_keywords.charge (face up under the hero, CR 8.5.29), where the 'considered to have charged' bookkeeping lives.

Charge appears in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately not re-authored; triggers.py maps the DB keyword to 'pass - card-specific', so there is no double-charge.

Adoption note: batch lists set BoltynBlitzDeck - derive the folder from the card's own sets/setIdentifiers in card_data/slug_index.json at adoption time.
